## Risks, rights and release

- [ ] No secret or credential included
- [ ] Ownership and publication permission for changed third-party identity, CV, media, projects, fonts and logos is explicitly recorded, or this PR is limited to access-controlled technical work
- [ ] Source deviations and unresolved dependencies (including Lenis) are documented
- [ ] Migration does not rewrite original Git history or push directly to `main`
- [ ] Human release approval is obtained separately; merging this PR does not itself authorize deployment
